 Jalen Smith impresses in start Wednesday 
 by Ari Koslow | Bulls Correspondent | Thu, Oct 22nd 2026, 2:23am EDT 
 Jalen Smith scored 15 points (5-10 FG, 0-3 3PT, 5-6 FT) to go along with eight rebounds, one assist and one block in the Bulls 135-135-92 loss against the Raptors. 
 Fantasy Impact: 
 Smith will continue to start for as long as Nic Claxton (hamstring) sidelined. He'll be on the streaming radar as a starter.
